name: Ever After
tagline: A wedding planner for Android: countdown, checklist, budget, guests and vendors in one place.
description:
Ever After is a wedding planner for Android. It brings the countdown to your wedding day, your checklist, budget, guest list and vendor list together in one place, styled like a letterpress stationery set.

Pick your wedding colours from eight schemes or choose your own, and use the app in light mode, dark mode or following your phone. Everything you enter is stored on your phone. There is no account to create.

Ever After is free with a small banner ad. A one-time "Remove ads" purchase turns the ads off.
features: Wedding checklist with a starter list of tasks
Eight wedding colour schemes, or your own colour
Data stays on your phone, no account needed
